physicalContract.sharedWallRule: Adjacent 28 metre structural bands share a wall/service line. Template margins are solid structure and services, never public voids.
physicalContract.galleryPiercingRule: The north–south crosscut occupies five threshold bays and the Core Questions Forum. It never crosses a gallery room.
physicalContract.inactivePortalRule: Every unused optional gallery portal remains a full-height collision wall and remains available for exhibit placement.
